address: 1F, 299 Lequn 3rd Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, 203, Taiwan
bio: Chef Frassi has styled his restaurant to remind diners of his Tuscan roots. It is only open in the evenings, serving one tasting menu that rolls out some seven courses of creative, contemporary Italian fare. Dishes like lobster risotto or rabbit tagliatelle are artfully plated, delivering excellent flavours and textures. The kitchen ages its own meat and its aged duck stands out in particular. Wine pairing in half or full glasses at sensible prices.
